Class Player

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.model.player.Player
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Player extends Object implements Serializable
Represents a participant in the game: identified by a Totem colour and a nickname, owning food, prestige points, a hand of cards and a set of buildings, and tracking aggregate PlayerStats. Also carries the connection flag used by the networking layer to skip disconnected players.

    • payFood

      public boolean payFood(int amount)
      Deducts food from this player's supply.

      Precondition: the caller must verify affordability before invoking this method (e.g. player.getFood() >= amount). This is an internal model operation and is never invoked without prior validation.

      Parameters:
      amount - the quantity of food to remove; must be ≥ 0 and ≤ current food balance
      Returns:
      true after the deduction succeeds
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if amount < 0 or amount > getFood()
